201:t_010:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「I know! I can't just leave it alone after seeing Miss $$スズネ$$ in tears! I'll drag $n out of here with a rope around the neck if I have to!」

201:t_010:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But as things stand, we have no opening to start a retreat...」

201:t_010:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...It was a mistake in our strategy...! Afraid of a scheme that may never have existed, we kept falling a step behind until we fell into a fatal situation...!」

201:t_010:30.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand now... the plan that $$ストラウス$$ set up.」

201:t_010:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Trampling us with overwhelming force...! So the absolute strategy was a head-on frontal assault!」

201:t_010:33.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Meet the unorthodox with the orthodox... That's how we meant to take them on, but when the orthodox meets the orthodox, the difference in strength decides the battle...」

201:t_010:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「She read us that far ahead?!」

201:t_010:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Is there no choice but to accept a sacrifice and create an opening...?」

201:t_010:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That man also tried to make himself a sacrifice for the world. I could, too...」

201:t_010:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's a fine resolve, $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

201:t_010:41.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「If you vanish here, that suits us fine. Then the Earth will...」

201:t_012:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Break away! We'll cover you!」

201:t_012:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is here too?!」

201:t_012:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm sorry for the trouble I caused you, $$バナージ$$. But there is no need to worry any longer.」

201:t_012:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I will fight as well. Together with you.」

201:t_012:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Save the touching reunion for later. The other side is raring to go.」

201:t_012:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「But don't worry! We've secured the retreat route!」

201:t_012:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「We'd been fighting the Empire in our own ways, too, but...」

201:t_012:11.en:
$$葵$$
「We couldn't exactly turn down an invitation from the $$赤い彗星$$, so here we are.」

201:t_012:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Cover them until every ship crosses that line!」

201:t_013:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's time for me to go as well.」

201:t_013:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Where are you going, $$アサキム$$!?」

201:t_013:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You should know. That I have nowhere to go.」

201:t_013:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But we will meet again soon. Guided by the $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_013:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Who needs a nuisance like that!」

201:t_013:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Until we meet again, you whose fates have been twisted.」

201:t_014:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come if you want to, puppet. Next time we meet, I'll put an end to your mission.」

201:t_014:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is our wish as well.」

201:t_014:7.en:
$n
「(I can't stake everything on some convenient hope, and I can't lash out in despair either...)」

201:t_015:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「All ships have reached the target point!」

201:t_015:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, prepare to withdraw as well!」

201:t_016:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Are we really not going to finish that bastard off?!」

201:t_016:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Retreat comes first right now! If we chase them recklessly, this time we'll fall into a situation we can't take back!」

201:t_017:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Are we really not going to finish that bastard off?!」

201:t_017:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Retreat comes first right now! If we chase them recklessly, this time we'll fall into a situation we can't take back!」

201:t_018:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Not a word even at a time like this?! You're the ultimate stone-faced jerk!」

201:t_018:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Are we really not going to finish that bastard off?!」

201:t_018:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Retreat comes first right now! If we chase them recklessly, this time we'll fall into a situation we can't take back!」

201:t_019:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$...! And the three $$スフィア・リアクター$$s!」

201:t_019:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That power was far beyond anything we imagined...」

201:t_019:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someday, without fail... we'll come here again...! And this time, to win!」

201:t_020:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「This feeling... It's definitely different from the other three...!」

201:t_021:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So he's run out of patience.」

201:t_021:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「So that's the master of this $$ラース・バビロン$$...」
